paths.description: Entry page and feed template: primary navigation, live scores, headline discovery and feed browsing.
Representative sport section/listing template, covering category navigation, live scores and news cards.
Primary scores journey, covering date/sport filters, match state and record actions.
Representative article/detail template, covering reading, metadata, images and no-JavaScript content.
Invalid route used to inspect HTTP/not-found recovery messaging and onward actions.

findings.summary: The rendered experience does not follow the system dark preference.
findings.evidence: The dark-condition screenshot remains white and the stylesheet only activates dark variables when an additional html.DARK_THEME class is present.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply the dark tokens directly inside prefers-color-scheme: dark (or initialise DARK_THEME from matchMedia before paint), declare color-scheme: light dark, and test every template.

findings.summary: A live badge keeps animating when reduced motion is requested.
findings.evidence: The reduced-motion probe found Home_animationLiveBadge__qHKcE running with a 1200 ms duration and no reduce override.
findings.suggestedFix: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, stop the pulsing badge or replace it with a static state change.

findings.summary: Route and major state changes do not use View Transitions.
findings.evidence: Downloaded authored CSS contains no view-transition rules, while navigation is a React-like route-driven experience.
findings.suggestedFix: Add same-document View Transitions for route and score/filter state changes, with a reduced-motion fallback.

findings.summary: The global menu uses a custom fixed div with role=dialog instead of the platform dialog/popover primitives.
findings.evidence: The opened-menu probe found a fixed DIV role=dialog and no native dialog or popover elements.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a dialog for modal navigation or popover for transient navigation, with declarative invocation and light dismiss.

findings.summary: Responsive adaptation is viewport-only rather than component-aware.
findings.evidence: Mobile and desktop screenshots adapt, but the downloaded main stylesheet contains no @container rule and computed container-type is normal.
findings.suggestedFix: Introduce container-type and @container rules for reusable score, card and feed components while retaining viewport fallbacks.

findings.summary: Numerous interactive targets are too small or tightly spaced on mobile.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse target-size failed, and the DOM probe counted 61 visible controls below 24 px in at least one dimension; keyboard focus itself remained visible.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase each target and its safe spacing to at least 24 by 24 CSS px, preferably 44 px for primary mobile controls.

findings.summary: The home page loads too slowly under Lighthouse mobile conditions.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured FCP 4.2 s, LCP 38.9 s, TBT 660 ms and a performance score of 0.40; the raw CDP trace corroborated a 6.71 s LCP.
findings.suggestedFix: Profile the LCP element, make it discoverable in initial HTML, prioritise it, and defer non-critical feed, font and analytics work.

findings.summary: Main-thread JavaScript blocks responsiveness during load.
findings.evidence: The trace recorded three long tasks, a longest task of 213 ms and 279 ms total blocking time; Lighthouse reported 4.6 s main-thread work and 660 ms TBT.
findings.suggestedFix: Break long tasks into schedulable units, defer feed modules, and load analytics and optional cards after primary content becomes interactive.

findings.summary: Critical resource delivery is excessively heavy and delayed.
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 127 requests and 5.58 MB transferred, including 3.94 MB of fonts; Lighthouse flagged render blocking, font display, cache lifetime and document latency.
findings.suggestedFix: Subset and consolidate fonts, preload only the critical face/LCP resource, use font-display, compress API payloads, cache immutable assets and remove the entry redirect.

findings.summary: Large amounts of unused CSS and JavaScript are shipped.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 278 KiB unused CSS and 1,389 KiB unused JavaScript, plus 100 KiB legacy JavaScript.
findings.suggestedFix: Code-split by template and card type, remove unused styles, conditionally load optional feed/advertising modules, and modernise the bundle target.

findings.summary: Feed images lack accessible alternatives.
findings.evidence: The images primitive reported 99 of 100 sampled images without alt; the later DOM probe still found 10 missing alt attributes and Lighthouse image-alt failed.
findings.suggestedFix: Give meaningful images concise alt text and mark purely decorative/team-logo duplicates alt="" or role=presentation.

findings.summary: Navigation and live-score text fail minimum contrast.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found ratios as low as 1.96:1 for blue sub-navigation text and 2.52:1 for muted header text against white.
findings.suggestedFix: Darken muted and inactive text tokens to meet 4.5:1 for normal text and 3:1 for large text and UI graphics.

findings.summary: The primary content has no main landmark.
findings.evidence: The DOM probe found zero main elements across the home template although headings and visible focus were present.
findings.suggestedFix: Wrap the unique feed/content area in main and preserve the existing skip link target and logical headings.

findings.summary: The viewport explicitly disables pinch zoom.
findings.evidence: Rendered metadata is width=device-width, maximum-scale=1, minimum-scale=1, user-scalable=no; Lighthouse meta-viewport failed.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove maximum-scale, minimum-scale and user-scalable restrictions so users can zoom to at least 200 percent.

findings.summary: Document and image asset hygiene is inconsistent.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reported charset missing or too late, while the rendered probe found an injected UTF-8 meta; the image audit found 10 images without dimensions and 66 oversized images.
findings.suggestedFix: Place meta charset=utf-8 in the first 1024 bytes of server HTML and emit intrinsic width/height and appropriate responsive sources for every image.

findings.summary: The page is ineligible for the back/forward cache.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reported three BFCache blockers led by Cache-Control: no-store on the main resource and JavaScript fetches.
findings.suggestedFix: Avoid no-store on public pages and non-sensitive data; use private or revalidation directives where needed and retest history navigation.

findings.summary: Public templates omit a meta description.
findings.evidence: Both the home probe and article probe returned no meta description; Lighthouse SEO failed meta-description.
findings.suggestedFix: Add unique, accurate descriptions for the home, section, scoreboard and article templates.

findings.summary: Indexing signals are incomplete and crawler policy hides most content.
findings.evidence: No canonical was present on home or article, /sitemap.xml returned the branded not-found page, robots.txt disallows all paths except home for generic crawlers and explicitly disallows article routes for Yeti.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish canonical URLs and a sitemap, align robots policy with intended public discovery, and allow article access to relevant search and AI crawlers if public reach is intended.

findings.summary: Article metadata lacks structured data and complete sharing fields.
findings.evidence: The article exposes og:title, og:image and og:type but no JSON-LD, canonical, meta description or observed og:url.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit accurate NewsArticle JSON-LD plus canonical, description, og:url and matching social metadata server-side.

findings.summary: The HTTPS response lacks core XSS and MIME defenses and sets a non-secure cookie.
findings.evidence: Headers found no CSP or X-Content-Type-Options; cookie NACT lacked Secure and all five cookies used SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a nonce/hash-based CSP, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, and mark every HTTPS cookie Secure with the narrowest workable SameSite policy.

findings.summary: The initial page has a broad telemetry and third-party-origin footprint.
findings.evidence: Tracker evidence observed 11 third-party origins, including tivan.naver.com, nam.veta.naver.com and nlog.naver.com; HAR attributed 124 requests and 5.58 MB to non-page origins.
findings.suggestedFix: Inventory each origin, remove nonessential calls, batch telemetry, gate advertising where required, and load optional third parties only after need or consent.

findings.summary: Defensive browser policies are incomplete and referrer leakage is maximised.
findings.evidence: The main response lacks frame protection, Permissions-Policy and CSP frame-ancestors, and sends Referrer-Policy: unsafe-url.
findings.suggestedFix: Set frame-ancestors or X-Frame-Options, a restrictive Permissions-Policy, and strict-origin-when-cross-origin or stricter Referrer-Policy.

findings.summary: The home and listing experience is an empty JavaScript shell for non-JS clients.
findings.evidence: Discoverability fetched 3,095 bytes of raw home HTML with zero content text, an empty #root and 0% rendered-word coverage; the crawler screenshot is blank.
findings.suggestedFix: Server-render the navigation, scores and initial headlines, then hydrate enhancements; keep real links and meaningful fallback content in raw HTML.

findings.summary: Image assets are frequently oversized and lack responsive delivery.
findings.evidence: The image audit found 66 oversized images, 36 without srcset, 15 legacy-format assets and no detected modern-format image.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve AVIF/WebP where appropriate, provide srcset/sizes, right-size logos and thumbnails, and retain intrinsic dimensions.

findings.summary: Below-fold feed assets and processing are loaded eagerly.
findings.evidence: The image audit found 41 below-fold images without loading=lazy, while the trace recorded repeated long tasks during the observation window.
findings.suggestedFix: Lazy-load below-fold feed media, virtualise or content-visibility defer deep cards, and deprioritise background fetch and processing.

findings.summary: The page weight is disproportionate for a score-and-news entry view.
findings.evidence: HAR measured 5.58 MB, of which 3.94 MB was five font requests and 5.58 MB was attributed to 124 cross-origin requests; Lighthouse measured a larger 12,076 KiB lab payload.
findings.suggestedFix: Set an explicit route budget, reduce font families/weights, defer optional media and third-party modules, and enforce the budget in monitoring.

findings.summary: Public sports content is not reliably machine-readable for agents and AI crawlers.
findings.evidence: The home is a 0%-coverage JS shell; article raw coverage is only 37%, raw title/H1 are absent, and robots.txt blocks Yeti from article paths.
findings.suggestedFix: Server-render semantic article and score data, expose complete structured metadata, and deliberately document/allow safe agent access to public content.

taskList.title: Restore fast initial rendering and reduce main-thread/network cost
Server-render public navigation, scores, headlines and article metadata
Fix image alternatives, contrast, zoom and target sizing
Optimise responsive images and below-fold media
Deploy CSP, cookie hardening and defensive browser policies
Make dark and reduced-motion preferences work automatically
Add descriptions, canonical URLs, sitemap and structured article data
Adopt component queries, semantic overlays and View Transitions
Restore BFCache eligibility and early charset declaration
